# Ridgewood Air Conditioning & Heating

> Home and light commercial HVAC company based in Ingleside, Texas, serving the Coastal Bend. Owner: Thomas (Tommy) Martinez. Texas license TACLB112804C, insured. Open 7 days (Mon to Fri 8am to 8pm · Sat 9am to 6pm · Sun 9am to 4pm); the price is the same on Sunday as on Tuesday; a real person answers the phone; pricing is given before any repair. Installs mostly Rheem, plus Daikin and Goodman; financing available. 5.0 stars from 38 Google reviews. Phone 361-608-9553 (call or text).

Does not service window units, restaurants, medical or industrial buildings.

## Services
- [AC & Heating System Replacement](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/services/ac-replacement/): When it's time to replace instead of patch: a full changeout with honest options, mostly Rheem, plus Daikin and Goodman. Financing available.
- [AC Repair](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/services/ac-repair/): Warm air, frozen coils, a breaker that trips when the AC kicks on. We find the real cause, and you get the price before any repair is made.
- [Heating Repair](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/services/heating-repair/): When the cold snap hits, we show up fast. We've even loaned a customer a space heater while their part was on order.
- [AC Tune-Ups & Maintenance](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/services/ac-tune-up/): Complete spring and fall checkups that catch small problems before they turn into breakdowns. The backbone of our Club Membership.
- [Ductwork & Duct Replacement](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/services/ductwork/): New duct runs and full duct replacement, so every room gets the airflow it's supposed to have.
- [Indoor Air Quality](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/services/indoor-air-quality/): Cleaner air at home, with air quality options matched to your house and your system.
- [Ductless Mini-Splits](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/services/mini-splits/): For additions, garages, workshops and rooms your main system can't keep comfortable.
- [Advanced Diagnostics](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/services/hvac-diagnostics/): Thermal imaging cameras and live digital system testing. We show you exactly what your system is doing, not just tell you.
- [Club Membership](https://jzonkel1.github.io/ridgewood-preview/club/): spring and fall checkups, priority service, 10% off repairs, no service fee for members.
